[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew a '''[[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]''' just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==History==
This Delta-7 began as an [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] commissioned just before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Highly advanced and carrying sophisticated equipment, it was an expensive [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to produce. The ship was armed with four laser cannons (many of the fighters were upgraded to contain two extra cannons behind breakaway panels after recommendations based on the flight-test and subsequent modifications made by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] for increased performance), and an advanced communication and sensor array that kept the pilot of the ship well-prepared for any circumstance that might arise during space travel.<ref>[[Hasbro]]'s Obi-Wan's Jedi Starfighter at [https://www.rebelscum.com/sagajedifighter.asp Rebelscum.com]</ref><ref>[[Hasbro]]'s Obi-Wan's Jedi Starfighter & HYPERSPACE RING at [https://www.rebelscum.com/tacobifighterring.asp Rebelscum.com]</ref>

[[File:Aethersprite-console.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Console display of Obi-Wan's Delta-7.]]
After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] found a damaged [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] during his inspection of the customizations to the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]], he rebuilt the ship that would then be assigned to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] with an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] dome. R4 became the prototype for other integrated droid navigators in [[Jedi starfighter]]s. As part of the Delta-7, the agromech had a truncated body, which was permanently attached to the ship. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was then assigned this Delta-7 in his service to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="AotC" /><ref name="CCS" /><ref name="Card-SWPM-Obi-Wan Kenobi's Jedi Starfighter">{{PocketModel|set=Order 66|cardname=Obi-Wan Kenobi's Jedi Starfighter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo18d.jpg}}</ref>

One of the most famous encounters involving this ship was the tracking of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] by Obi-Wan through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Jango noticed Kenobi in pursuit and attempted to finish off the Jedi once and for all by leading him through Geonosis' rings. Obi-Wan's Delta-7 was damaged and he was forced to hide on the back of an asteroid as Fett descended onto Geonosis. Kenobi then used the fighter to land near a gathering of Separatist ships. Upon discovering a plot of several systems scheming to secede from the Republic, Obi-Wan used the on-board [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holotransceiver]] to alert the Jedi Council. When he was captured while sending his message, the fighter was likely impounded by Separatist forces; however, it was apparently recovered after or during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] that took place later on that planet, and saw further use by Kenobi during the advent of the Clone Wars.<ref name="AotC" />

When the Jedi began to transition away from the Delta-7, R4-P17 was removed from the ship and given a full astromech body to make her compatible with Obi-Wan's new [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]]. It is unknown what became of the Delta-7 after this.<ref name="CCS" />
